Q1: Ferric sulfate is recognized by the Globally Harmonized System (Tier 1) for significant oral and dermal/eye hazards. An expanded perspective (Tier 2) suggests potential environmental and inhalation hazards. Conversely, it is also found on FDA lists for substances added to food and those Generally Recognized As Safe (GRAS), suggesting its low hazard status is likely limited to very low quantities under highly regulated conditions.
